<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 490" width="600" height="490">
  <defs>
    <marker id="ah" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="8" refY="4" orient="auto-start-reverse" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M0,0 L8,4 L0,8 z" fill="#000"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="600" height="490" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- axes -->
  <line x1="60" y1="400" x2="60" y2="40" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="400" x2="560" y2="400" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
  <text x="18" y="36" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#000">Energy</text>
  <text x="560" y="430" text-anchor="end" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#000">Progress of reaction</text>

  <!-- reactant and product levels -->
  <line x1="90" y1="200" x2="520" y2="200" stroke="#000" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-dasharray="2 3"/>
  <line x1="500" y1="330" x2="520" y2="330" stroke="#000" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-dasharray="2 3"/>

  <!-- without catalyst (solid) -->
  <path d="M90,200 C160,190 200,100 260,100 C330,100 390,330 500,330" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- with catalyst (dashed) -->
  <path d="M90,200 C150,195 200,150 250,150 C310,150 400,330 500,330" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="8 5"/>
  <circle cx="250" cy="150" r="3" fill="#000"/>

  <!-- activation energy -->
  <line x1="250" y1="100" x2="250" y2="200" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" marker-start="url(#ah)" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
  <text x="264" y="176" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="17" font-style="italic" fill="#000">E<tspan font-size="12" dy="4">a</tspan></text>

  <!-- enthalpy change -->
  <line x1="520" y1="200" x2="520" y2="330" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" marker-start="url(#ah)" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
  <text x="532" y="270" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="17" font-style="italic" fill="#000">ΔH</text>

  <!-- labels -->
  <text x="96" y="226" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#000">reactants</text>
  <text x="500" y="352" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#000">products</text>
  <text x="330" y="88" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#000">without catalyst</text>
  <line x1="215" y1="250" x2="246" y2="156" stroke="#000" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <text x="140" y="262" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#000">with catalyst</text>

  <!-- caption -->
  <text x="300" y="472" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#000">Fig. 4.1</text>
</svg>

The y-axis arrowhead is drawn sideways and the "Energy" label runs into the arrow tip.
